summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly open-market repurchases of its ordinary shares under an existing buyback programme. Purchases were made from UBS AG, London Branch, on 1 September 2026 across three venues: LSE (762,560 shares), CHIX (29,885), and BATE (10,922), at volume-weighted average prices of 671.63p, 673.19p, and 672.92p respectively. The buyback follows instructions issued 16 February 2026; shares will be cancelled. Post-settlement, NatWest holds 178,375,490 treasury shares with 7,949,276,140 in issue, providing a voting-rights denominator. Transaction details per UK MAR are linked. This routine buyback execution confirms ongoing capital returns; watch for programme completion and further tranches.
